Bio-Monitoring Corporation was founded in Edmonton with the mission of bridging biotechnology and nutrition through microbial innovation. Rooted in over two decades of scientific research and industrial experience in microbial genetics and fermentation, our work harnesses beneficial bacteria to develop bio-based solutions that support human health and sustainability. Our flagship initiative, the BioFolate Project, leverages optimized Lactobacillus strains to ferment and produce natural folic acid (vitamin B9). This forward-looking innovation helps reduce dependence on synthetic vitamins and drives environmentally responsible nutraceutical production in Alberta.

They produce highly bioactive, natural folic acid through precision fermentation, which can be used by food, supplement, and pharma brands. They also offer a "Folic Acid supplement" that is natural, active, and organic, MTHFR‑Friendly, with 1,000 mcg / 1 mg and is intended for "Pre‑conception & Prenatal Support."
